page_objective: Define the strategic identity, positioning, visual philosophy, and engineering mindset behind the SIPANEL brand system.

brand_core.core_message: SIPANEL reduces industrial panel project risk through precise design, smart procurement, and engineered installation.
brand_core.brand_positioning: Engineering-first industrial panel systems company focused on risk reduction, waterproofing logic, material optimization, and controlled project execution.
brand_core.brand_promise: Deliver technically coordinated industrial panel systems with measurable execution control and engineering clarity.

principles.title: Engineering Before Marketing
principles.description: Every visual, message, and interaction must communicate technical confidence and execution clarity.

principles.title: Proof Over Claims
principles.description: Use measurable project evidence instead of exaggerated marketing language.

principles.title: Controlled Execution
principles.description: The brand should communicate structure, predictability, and engineering discipline.

principles.title: Industrial Clarity
principles.description: Design must remain clean, technical, and highly readable across all devices.

principles.title: Risk Reduction Mindset
principles.description: Every communication should connect back to reducing project risk, leakage, waste, delays, or rework.

color_identity.orange_usage_rule: Orange should be reserved for CTAs, engineering highlights, key metrics, and technical emphasis only.
color_identity.dark_usage_rule: Dark sections should be used strategically to create hierarchy and technical authority.

typography_identity.tone: Bold, technical, modern, and highly readable.

visual_direction: Dark technical sections balanced with light layouts

implementation_notes: All future brand, UI, content, and frontend decisions must align with these identity principles.
The SIPANEL brand must always communicate engineering confidence before marketing appeal.
Consistency across multilingual implementations is mandatory.
